component.name: 3D Pinball Space Cadet Talking
component.summary: Creatiel fork of SpaceCadetPinball with voice announcements, gameplay enhancements and expanded controller support

description.p: 3D Pinball Space Cadet Talking is a Creatiel fork of SpaceCadetPinball 2.1.0, the cross-platform SDL port by Andrey Muzychenko.
This version adds voice announcements, new gameplay options, improved Tilt control, configurable Center Post duration, an Extra Ball counter and expanded support for generic joysticks.
Original game by Cinematronics for Maxis. Windows version by Microsoft.
